# The AI Fundi

> Chris Conley builds websites, applications and practical AI systems for businesses. Based in Germany, serving clients worldwide.

## Founder
Chris Conley is the founder of The AI Fundi and a Global AI Innovation Lead. He helps businesses turn ideas into useful digital products and explains technical decisions in plain language.

## Services
- Websites: Business websites, landing pages and redesigns.
- Applications: Web applications, internal tools and customer portals.
- AI systems: Practical automations, content workflows and integrations.
- AI opportunity audits: Business reviews, priorities and action plans.

## Selected work
The portfolio includes Kiddo, Discovery Child Care, Greenjack Capital, MacArthur Flournoy, Dolce Flowers, Jimi Nu, Across the King’s River, Blooms & Botanicals, Hakuna Matata, Delta Personal Services, Precision Fabricated Components, St. Annis Baptist Church, and Prisms & Platters.

## Community
[The AI Fundi Lab](https://www.skool.com/aifundi) is a paid community with step-by-step builds, weekly live sessions, templates and practical AI learning.
